game_concept: A tower defense set in The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row, a street of busy forges: the baker's apprentice must handle shadow scouts while practicing variables & assignment. Core idea – Constant Guardian: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the drawbridge.
theme: The Kingdom – Blacksmith Row: a street of busy forges
core_gameplay_loop: In Blacksmith Row, repeat each round: Tell fixed CONSTANTS from changeable variables; only change variables to unlock the drawbridge. Each round, shadow scouts strike the drawbridge, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the energy value and advance.
player_objective: Protect the drawbridge from shadow scouts in Blacksmith Row: keep the energy meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 46-second timer ends.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
lose_condition: energy drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 46-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 1 – Variables & Assignment | Level 2 (intro tier): Constant Guardian
assets_style: storybook pixel-art kingdom: green meadows, red-roofed towers, royal blue and gold trim; flat Kenney-style sprites; bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Constant Guardian' (Week 1 slot 7), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Blacksmith Row'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: The Kingdom
region.mood: bright medieval lute and fanfare with market chatter

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how energy changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against shadow scouts in Blacksmith Row.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 46 seconds while energy > 0.
